info.name: Box Authorize Authorization Sign Templates API

params.name: marker
params.description:
Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results. This is
used when paginating using marker-based pagination.

This requires `usemarker` to be set to `true`.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

items.docs: Gets Box Sign templates created by a user.

info.name: Get Box Sign template by ID

params.name: template_id
params.description: The ID of a Box Sign template.
